phase: Phase 1: Photo checks, then the remaining fixes
summary: Delta d43334ba6..ac1e54efd closes r1 findings F1, F2, and F3, adds the PM 10 percent text-overlap rule (F4), and centers the home Mastery card below lg with a failing-first assertion. The gate log shows 56 passed with retries 0, and the Red r3 log shows the new Mastery assertion failing first at d43334ba6. The two fooling vectors named for F4 are safe by inspection. One new nonblocking finding stays: the 10 percent text rule has never been observed to fire in any recorded run.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Fixed] The aspect and short-side rule now covers every loaded photo whose src holds /images/products/, every photo in a program-card or product-block ancestor, and /images/blended-learning.png through PRODUCT_EXTRA_PICTURE_FILES (photos.spec.ts:800-804). The Tutor picture and the report-results picture are inside the rule. A non-vacuity guard pushes a problem when the list is empty (photos.spec.ts:805-807). spec.md AC-1 records the wider scope.

F2 [Fixed] An img in a page main element with an empty src now adds a problem instead of being skipped (photos.spec.ts:180-190), and every page in the set has a main element (home page.tsx:115, marketing layout.tsx, about page.tsx, products, pricing, services). The badge skip needs both signals: a file name that starts with qr, logo, or icon, and an alt that names a logo, an icon, or a QR code (photos.spec.ts:166-171), so a photo named icon-guide.png still counts. Both rules are written into spec.md AC-1.

F3 [Fixed] Plan task 1.1 now states that the pre-fix e2e run was skipped and that the hero unit test at 8193625ca^ is the pre-fix proof. The stale claim is gone, and the remediation r3 sub-line repeats the correction.

F4 [Verified with a proof gap] The 10 percent text rule measures the union of clipped text boxes with coordinate compression (photos.spec.ts:418-530). A text element that is the photo's ancestor is skipped, but an ancestor's own text nodes cannot paint over an in-flow child image without contrived float or negative-margin CSS, and spec.md AC-1 documents the skip. A figcaption is skipped only when its top starts at or below the photo bottom, where it cannot intersect, so an overlapping caption is counted. The rule runs on the same counted set as the cover test, which matches the thumbnail rule. The proof gap is tracked as F5.

F5 [Medium] The 10 percent text rule has no failing-first proof and no recorded nonzero measurement. Grep over /tmp/opencode/a62-r3-e2e.log returns 12 report lines, all textOverlap=0%, and zero textBoxes= labels. The Red r3 run at d43334ba6 failed only the Mastery card assertion, so no case ever exercised the union measure past zero. A natural fixture existed at 40419d4bc, where the report-results text box covered blended-learning.png 100 percent, and it was not run. Static reading finds the union algorithm correct, so the finding stays nonblocking. Cheap proof: run the new spec against a build of 40419d4bc and confirm the text rule fails that case.

D1 [Accepted deviation, carried from r1] The See How We Report Results card stays stacked at every width. The grid is md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 (b2b-solutions.tsx:216), so the cell is one third wide at lg, and the stacked card keeps text off the photo.

F4 ancestor check: the loop skips element.contains(img); an ancestor's own text nodes are in normal flow and cannot paint over an in-flow child image, and spec.md AC-1 states the skip as a rule

F4 union check: coordinate compression with midpoint sampling over the clipped boxes, divided by the visible photo area, the same denominator as the cover test
